List all available fields for this object kind, grouped by:
  - Common fields (inherited from base_object/auditable, available for all objects)
  - Specialized fields (specific to this object kind)

Fields are sorted alphabetically and include:
  - Field name
  - Type (string, integer, list, etc.)
  - Semantic type (statement, reference, quantity, etc.)
  - Traits (listable, readable, writable, filterable, sortable, etc.)
  - Required status
  - Description

This command is accessed via the kind command group, making it convenient to explore
object structure: '%s object <kind> fields'

  List all fields
  zqk object backlog_item fields
  List only filterable fields
  zqk object backlog_item fields --filterable
  List only sortable fields
  zqk object backlog_item fields --sortable
  List only groupable fields
  zqk object backlog_item fields --groupable
  List only specialized fields
  zqk object backlog_item fields --specialized-only

Usage:
  zqk object <kind> fields [flags]

Flags:
      --filterable         Show only filterable fields
      --format string      Output format: table, json, yaml (default "table")
      --groupable          Show only groupable fields
      --sortable           Show only sortable fields
      --specialized-only   Show only specialized fields (exclude common fields)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
